<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"
    xmlns:ev="http://www.w3.org/2001/xml-events"
    xmlns:w2="http://www.inswave.com/websquare" xmlns:xf="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms">
    <head meta_screenName="레이아웃-기본">
        <w2:type>DEFAULT</w2:type>
        <w2:buildDate/>
        <xf:model>
            <xf:instance>
                <data xmlns=""/>
            </xf:instance>
            <w2:dataCollection baseNode="map"></w2:dataCollection>
            <w2:workflowCollection>
            </w2:workflowCollection>
        </xf:model>
         <script type="text/javascript" lazy="false"><![CDATA[
//BEGIN---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------//

/**
 * scframe용 main설정 (참고) 업무영역에서는 필요없음
 *
 * ============= ============ ==========================
 *  Date          Author       Description
 * ============= ============ ==========================
 *  2022.09.01.   안종광        [NELS]최초 생성
 * ============= ============ ==========================
 */
scwin.isMain = function() {
    return true;
};

scwin.H_LOADED = false;
scwin.W_LOADED = false;
scwin.BPOP_CNTR = psp.CONTEXT_ROOT+"/ui/pspcom/PSPBPopCntr.xml"; //PSPBPopContainer //브라우저팝업 컨테이너
scwin.HELP      = psp.CONTEXT_ROOT+"/ui/pspcom/PSPHelpM01.xml";

/**
 * 화면 로드
 * (주의) WebSquare.net.paramObj 에는 값에 특수문자 담긴 파라미터는 전달되지 않음. 필요시 psputils.urlparams() 로 대체
 * (예제) &ru=http://localhost:81/pjg/index.on%3Fm%3DPJG112M00&
 * 
 * ============= ============ ==========================
 *  Date          Author       Description
 * ============= ============ ==========================
 *  2022.09.01.   안종광        [NELS]최초 생성
 *  2024.06.11.   안종광        URL파리미터전달 처리 추가
 * ============= ============ ==========================
 */
scwin.onpageload = function() {
    _debug("[@default#onpageload] WebSquare.baseURI =", WebSquare.baseURI); // /websquare/
    var paramObj = psputils.urlparams(); //WebSquare.net.paramObj; //{m: 'PJG171M01', s: 'PJG171M01', debugger: 'on', search: '%EA%B2%80%EC%83%89%EC%96%B4'}
    if ( ! psp.ss.hasData("psp_allmenu") ) {
        scutilo.isEmpty(psp.session()) ? psp.get_allmenu_list(true) : psp.getUserMenu(true);
    }

    // 중복로그인 체크
    var dupLoginYn = psp.getSession("dupLoginYn");
    _debug("[@default#onpageload]", "<dupLoginYn>", dupLoginYn);
    if("Y"==dupLoginYn) {
		
    	scutilo.showMsg(scglblo.MSG.WARN, scutilo.getMsg(pspmsg.PSP.W_0000, "다른 컴퓨터에서 같은 사용자가 로그인 하셨습니다.\n본 컴퓨터는 자동 로그아웃 됩니다."), function() {
    			psp.clearSesn(9); //중복로그인 Redis Key 제거 포함
    			psp.go_url();
    		
    		});
    	return;
    }

    // URL파리미터전달 처리 추가 @2024.06.11 :: https://localhost/psp/index.on?m=PSP611M01&s=PSP611M02&elpNtcMtrSrno=47
    if ( "PSP611M02"==paramObj["s"] && paramObj["elpNtcMtrSrno"] ) {
        var ntcParam = {
            "dma_search":{"findType":"1", "findText":"", "totalCnt":1,"pageNo":1,"pageSize":"10"},
            "rowdata":{"elpNtcMtrSrno": paramObj["elpNtcMtrSrno"]}
        };
        psp.ss.set(psp.SS_PAGEPARAM, ntcParam);
    }

    psp.load_page(paramObj.m, paramObj.s, paramObj);
    
    // Android Back-Key Listener
    if (psp.env.isMobileApp()) {
        $h.backKeyPressedListener(function(e) {
            window.history.back();
        });
    }
};

/**
 * 페이지 언로드
 *
 * ============= ============ ==========================
 *  Date          Author       Description
 * ============= ============ ==========================
 *  2022.09.01.   안종광        [NELS]최초 생성
 * ============= ============ ==========================
 */
scwin.onpageunload = function() {
    _trace("[@default#onpageunload] PspMainDefault page un-loaded!");
};

//END-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------//
]]></script>
    <style type="text/css"><![CDATA[

         ]]></style>
    </head>
    <body ev:onpageload="scwin.onpageload" ev:onpageunload="scwin.onpageunload">
    	<xf:group class="skip_navi" id="" style="" tagname="ul">
    		<xf:group class="menu2" id="" style="" tagname="li">
    			<w2:anchor href="#mf_pfwork" id="" outerDiv="false" style="">
    				<xf:label><![CDATA[본문 바로가기]]></xf:label>
    			</w2:anchor>
    		</xf:group>
    		<xf:group class="menu1" id="" style="" tagname="li">
    			<w2:anchor href="#mf_pfheader_depth1_menu5" id="" outerDiv="false" style="">
    				<xf:label><![CDATA[주메뉴 바로가기]]></xf:label>
    			</w2:anchor>
    		</xf:group>
    		<xf:group class="menu2" id="" style="" tagname="li">
    			<w2:anchor href="#mf_pfmenu_tbx_ltop_title" id="" outerDiv="false" style="">
    				<xf:label><![CDATA[서브메뉴 바로가기]]></xf:label>
    			</w2:anchor>
    		</xf:group>
    	</xf:group><xf:group id="pfmain" class="poter_wrap" style="">
    		<w2:wframe id="pfheader" src="/psp/ui/pspcom/pfhead01.xml" class="header" style=""></w2:wframe>
    		<w2:wframe id="pfpath" src="/psp/ui/pspcom/pflocation.xml" class="pg_location" style=""></w2:wframe>
    		<xf:group id="pfworkgroup" class="container inner" style="">
    			<w2:wframe id="pfmenu" src="/psp/ui/pspcom/pfmenu.xml" class="lnb" style=""></w2:wframe>
    			<w2:wframe id="pfwork" src="" class="" style=""></w2:wframe>
    		</xf:group>
    		<w2:wframe id="pfright" src="/psp/ui/pspcom/pfright.xml" class="right_cnts" style="z-index: 50;"></w2:wframe>
    		<w2:wframe id="pffooter" src="/psp/ui/pspcom/pffooter.xml" class="footer" style=""></w2:wframe>
    	</xf:group>
    	
    </body>
</html>
